slap

If Slap battles and Tower defense genre had a child then it would be like this! 
Slap Battles Tower Defense (sbtd for short) is a Tower Defense game themed to Slap Battles!

- Slap enemies for slaps (pro currency name ik).
- Place towers and upgrade them to defeat the bosses!
- Buy new towers, and create your own tower empire!

games.name: [💥🔺 UPD 1.7] untitled robot boxing
games.desc:
- THIS GAME IS GETTING REWORKED! THANK YOU FOR PLAYING THE ALPHA! -

make robots fight viciously with dynamic controls, and clanking noises.

Untitled Robot Boxing is a game heavily inspired by Real Steel. It is a 1v1 fighting game where you're put in 5 rounds that last 2 minutes. Your objective is to win by knocking out the enemy, winning by decision, or tearing their parts off!

• You earn Currency which you can use to spin for more robots 💵
• Perform a wide range of combos with the game's dynamic controls! 🕹
• Fight your way to the top! Can you make it to the top 10? 🏆

====
CONTROLS

I/J - LIGHT
K/L - HEAVY

D + I/J/K/L - FORWARD VARIANT ATTACK
S + I/J/K/L - DOWNWARD VARIANT ATTACK

F - HIGH BLOCK
V - LOW BLOCK

SPACE + WASD - DASH
SHIFT + WASD  - WEAVE

P - TECH MOVE/SPECIAL MOVE
====

• Game made as a solo dev. Thanks for playin'! Bugs or suggestions? Visit our social links!
